newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Rifail-Oil makes biggest Sibneft stake bid.
newsitem.headline: Russian Rifail-Oil makes biggest Sibneft stake bid.

text.p: Russia's ZAO Rifail-Oil made the biggest bid in an investment tender for a 15 percent stake in oil company OAO Sibneft but has not yet been formally declared the winner, an auction official said on Friday.
No information about Rifail-Oil was immediately available.
The company bid $35.49 million for the stake. This sum included $2.2 million to clear Sibneft's tax arrears within three months.
Sibneft is one of around a dozen vertically-integrated Russian oil companies created as part of a restructuring of the industry.
In the tender, 677.46 million shares with a nominal value of more than 1.08 billion roubles were on offer for a minimum 65.04 billion roubles.
The minimum investment, including the sum to repay the tax debts, was $33.56 million.
A Russian company called Sins won an investment tender for a 19 percent stake in Sibneft in September.
Neftyanaya Finansovaya Kompaniya (NFK) and Stolichny Bank Sberezhenii won the right to manage a 51 percent stake in Sibneft in a shares-for-loans auction late last year.
Foreigners are restricted to a 15 percent stake in the Sibneft, which is 51 percent state owned.
The company's main crude oil production unit is Noyabrskneftegaz.
